arabic text: AMMA KI NIGAHON SE MERA ZAKHM CHUPANA
english translation text: HIDE MY WOUNDS FROM MY MOTHER

arabic text: BABA MERE SEENE ME SINA TOOT GAYI HAI
english translation text: THE DAGGER HAS BROKEN IN MY CHEST

arabic text: IS TARHA KALEJE ME UTAR AAYI HAI BARCH
english translation text: THE DAGGER HAS HIT MY CHEST IN SUCH A WAY

arabic text: SEENA NAHI ARMAAN BHI MAA KE HUWE ZAKHMI
english translation text: NOT JUST MY CHEST, EVEN MY MOTHERS HOPES WERE WOUNDED

arabic text: CHAHA THA MERI MAA NE MUJHE DULHA BANA NA
english translation text: MY MOTHER WANTED TO SEE ME AS A GROOM

arabic text: JEE CHAHTA HAI AAP KI TASLEEM KO UTHU
english translation text: MY HEART WISHES TO STAND AND SAY SALAAM

arabic text: RUTBE KA TAQAAZA HAI KE TAZEEM KO UTHU
english translation text: I KNOW YOUR STATUS, AND I WISH TO STAND FOR YOU

arabic text: MUSHKIL HAI MAGAR HAATH KALEJE SE HATANA
english translation text: HOWEVER, IT IS DIFFICULT FOR ME TO MOVE MY HANDS FROM MY CHEST

arabic text: ME JAANTA HOO(N) ZID WO BOHOT TUM SE KAREGI
english translation text: I KNOW SHE WILL BE STUBBORN WITH YOU

arabic text: TANHA TUMHE ZAINAB KABHI AANE NAHI DEGI
english translation text: ZAINAB WILL NOT LET YOU COME TO THE BATTLEFIELD ALONE

arabic text: MAQTAL ME MERI PAALNE WALI KO NA LANA
english translation text: DON’T BRING THE ONE WHO BROUGHT ME UP TO THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: YEH SOCH KE AKBAR KA PHATA JATA HAI SEENA
english translation text: AKBAR’S HEART BREAKS WHEN HE THINKS OF THIS

arabic text: AWAAZ NA SUNLE KAHIN MASOOM SAKINA
english translation text: THAT SAKINA SHOULD NOT HEAR ABOUT MY SITUATION

arabic text: SAJJAD KO AAHISTA ZARA JAA KE BATAANA
ALLAH KARE LAUT KE TUM JAAWO WATAN KO
english translation text: I PRAY (TO MY LORD) THAT YOU RETURN HOME

arabic text: MAJBOORIAN BHAI KI BATA DENA BAHAN KO
english translation text: GO AND TELL SUGHRA ABOUT MY TROUBLES

arabic text: TUM MERI TARAF SE USSE SEENE SE LAGANA
english translation text: GIVE HER (MY SISTER) A HUG FROM ME
